description: This Java class, ShortcutHelper, provides utility functions to manage Android app shortcuts using the ShortcutManager API. It includes methods to create, refresh, add, remove, enable, and disable shortcuts, often related to websites or URLs, along with handling shortcut metadata and favicon fetching.

classes.name: ShortcutHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing Android app shortcuts, including creation, updating, enabling/disabling, and fetching favicons for website shortcuts.

methods.name: ShortcutHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing ShortcutHelper with application context and ShortcutManager.

methods.name: maybeRestoreAllDynamicShortcuts
methods.description: Checks and potentially restores dynamic shortcuts if none exist.

methods.name: reportShortcutUsed
methods.description: Reports usage of a shortcut by its ID.

methods.name: callShortcutManager
methods.description: Helper method to execute ShortcutManager operations with error handling and rate limiting.

methods.name: getShortcuts
methods.description: Retrieves a combined list of mutable dynamic and pinned shortcuts, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: refreshShortcuts
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes shortcuts based on last refresh time, updating stale shortcuts.

methods.name: createShortcutForUrl
methods.description: Creates a ShortcutInfo object for the given URL string.

methods.name: setSiteInformation
methods.description: Sets labels and icon for a shortcut based on website URL.

methods.name: setExtras
methods.description: Adds timestamp info to ShortcutInfo extras for refresh tracking.

methods.name: normalizeUrl
methods.description: Ensures URL starts with http:// or https://

methods.name: addWebSiteShortcut
methods.description: Adds a new website shortcut given its URL.

methods.name: fetchFavicon
methods.description: Downloads favicon.ico from the website URL.
